name: prayer-times
description: Daily prayer times in the status line, with a reminder before each prayer and a toast when it begins.

city.title: City
city.description: Your city ("Istanbul") or coordinates ("41.01, 28.98"). Leave blank to detect it from your IP.

method.title: Calculation method
method.description: The Fajr and Isha angles. Auto picks the one used in your country.

ihtiyatMinutes.title: Ihtiyat (minutes)
ihtiyatMinutes.description: Safety margin added to each prayer time; -1 uses the method's own (2 for Kemenag and JAKIM, 0 elsewhere).

reminderMinutes.title: Reminder (minutes before)
reminderMinutes.description: How early to remind you; 0 turns the early reminder off.

sunnahReminders.title: Dhuha and Tahajud reminders
sunnahReminders.description: A toast when the time for Dhuha, and for Tahajud (the last third of the night), begins, and a note under the prompt while it lasts.
